description: Find the destinations SimOptions sells travel eSIMs for, by country or region name in any language, or by code. Returns up to 10 destinations, best match first: each one's code (pass it to plans_find), name, type (country or region), the countries it covers and its page on simoptions.com. A country with no page of its own is answered with the regional plans that cover it.

query.description: Country or region name in any language, or its code: "Japan", "Europe", "JP". At least 2 characters.
